card.name: Sborenka
card.profile: A circle/line dance from the Dobrudzha region of northeastern Bulgaria, performed in 2/4 time. The name translates as 'together / a gathering.' Dobrudzhan style is moderate-tempo, danced with the body leaning slightly back, chest forward, knees bent, and prominent shoulder and arm movements that mimic agricultural work (sowing, harvesting, kneading bread) - Dobrudzha being 'the granary of Bulgaria.' Typically a mixed circle or semicircle; men also dance it as a distinct men's dance (Svet Dimitrov; Magic of Art).
card.insight: It is one of the signature dances of Dobrudzha, listed alongside Raka, Opas, Tropanka and the Dobrudzhanski ruchenik in regional repertoires (Svet Dimitrov).
card.image_significance: Dobrudzha's earthy 'gathering' dance. A representative image shows folk dress and patterned partner or group figures — Dobrudzha, Bulgaria.
